properties.name: Indiel-Lucas stock alternator
properties.description:
This part generates the electrical power needed for igniting the air fuel mixture in the engine. It is driven by a belt that connects to the crankshaft. 
 In short race conditions you may dismount this part to produce some more horsepower because the battery holds enough charge for ignition, but only for some minutes.

properties.name: Ford stock clutch
properties.description:
A well designed light clutch made for the low to middle level performance Baierns. 
 It's a 3.5 kg (7.72 pounds) diaphragm style clutch with a static pressure of 1250. 
 Pressure plate diameter is 250 mm (9.84 inch), useful contact area is 452 sq.cm (70 sq.inch).
